# TDPdf v1.23.2.0

**Fixes Insert Signature closing the application and Insert Text Box appearing to do nothing. Please upgrade as soon as this reaches you.**

TDPdf protects its annotation canvas and page grid from a rare Windows layout race. Windows can omit an internal framework frame from optimized crash information, and the protection in 1.23.1.0 still depended on that frame being present. When it was absent, TDPdf treated the known recoverable race as a new error instead of retrying layout.

This release recognises both forms while keeping the check narrow enough that unrelated errors from controls inside the page are not hidden. It also adds privacy-safe placement breadcrumbs—only Text or Signature and whether setup completed—so an interrupted placement can be diagnosed without collecting document content.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.23.2.0, so managed machines pick this up on the next evaluation. Assignments are unaffected.

Versions 1.23.0.0 and 1.23.1.0 are affected. Upgrade both.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to confirm the download independently.
